items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And this here is Emil Christian and Tony Parenti. [INTERVIEWEE] She's only keeping this stuff since we moved back in this place.
